subject: Framework Agreement between the Government of Canada and the European Investment Bank Governing the Activities of the European Investment Bank in Canada “Agreement”
precis: Order authorizing the Prime Minister or the Minister of Foreign Affairs, or a delegate, to sign, on behalf of the Government of Canada, subject to ratification, the Framework Agreement between the Government of Canada and the European Investment Bank Governing the Activities of the European Investment Bank in Canada.
